SSDLC-Platform-Lab portal (DESIGN.md D10, Milestone 8 — not yet built)
Style reference: SENTECH Homepage v2 Proposal + SENTECH Intranet Design Spec (IBM Plex, navy #003d7a / blue #1668C1, 24px rhythm)
All content grounded in the platform's real gate steps, SADRs and onboard-repo.sh flow — not generic placeholder.

Automated-remediation direction: the gate itself raises fix PRs for deterministic findings (dependency bumps, secret revocation). Interactive — click through queue → PR detail (Conversation/Files/Checks tabs) → policy. Grounded directly in gate-contract.json, bot-approver.py, policy-eval/evaluate-findings.py.

Selected direction. Same automated-remediation flow as V2, dark theme, plus a login screen. Extended past V2's original scope with a working Exceptions screen (two-party approval, wired to the sidebar) and a 6-step Onboarding wizard matching the real onboard-repo.sh sequence. Two bugs found and fixed here: only the first PR row in the queue was clickable (others had a null handler), and the "Awaiting human" stat didn't match the actual PR list (said 3/2, corrected to 2/1).
